body:
Feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. My note below says chalky water came from the feed test; the ditch smelled metallic before the noon siren sounded.

The children asked why the same place had two different names on the two papers. I told them to hold on to both until we knew.

The younger one wanted to throw it away. I promised we would ask in the morning, and put it where neither of us could forget.
title: Weathered bundle note — Friday at closing

body: The car burned after they copied its registration onto the clear list. I watched them carry a new list to the far side of the road. My father was told he had never arrived, although his name was on my first copy.
title: Two copies of a plate
